firm_data.firm_description: Hoffman Warnick is singularly dedicated to intellectual property law. Formed in 1999, they built their firm on an important goal: to resolve each of their clients’ intellectual property needs through customized service in the most responsive yet cost-effective manner.
notable_facts: Obtain in excess of 400 patents for clients annually.
Clients include small start-ups, mid-sized companies, Fortune 100 companies, and colleges and universities.

email.subject: AI for Hoffman Warnick, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

With over 400 patents obtained annually for your clients, your team is handling volume and complexity that demands precision. I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing BigLaw-scale work with leaner teams.

We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of boutique IP practices: accuracy, client trust, and cost efficiency. Our founding team includes ex-lawyers who understand patent prosecution workflows inside out.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your Albany office to show how we're helping firms like yours compete without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
